title: Choose the visual world for the climb
question: The roll assigned The Kit Catalog. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Kit Catalog
options.thesis: The ascent as an expedition catalog: every camp a numbered page of kit, every role a piece of gear on its tag.
options.viewport: A kraft catalog cover, ORDER No. 8849 in huge black numerals, a line-drawn ice axe and carabiner plate, the name set like a catalog title, an orange tag: Start the climb.
options.risk: Kraft and line art can drift into outdoor-brand nostalgia if the orange and black are not allowed to dominate.

raised.raise: Altitude is the one warm, lit readout on the page, and each digit rolls over mechanically as you climb.
Every camp headline holds a fixed three-tier stack: hook, title, promise.
One camp per full-width row, the altitude gained ruled beside it like a chalk measurement.
Every item is seamed to its caption with a visible stitched rule.

options.label: Landeskarte Route
options.thesis: The climb drawn as a red route line up a contour map, inked further with every scroll.
options.viewport: The summit massif in contours filling the screen, the red route starting at a Base Camp tent symbol, the name set in the map's legend.
options.risk: Maps are the most familiar 'journey' metaphor; this is where most runs land.

options.label: Glyph Everest
options.thesis: Everest rendered live in monospace glyphs; the camera climbs and the alphabet redraws the mountain.
options.viewport: A full-screen ASCII peak in amber, the name and altitude living inside the same character grid.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and speaks straight to a gaming and tech audience; loses on clarity for photos and film credits.
options.risk: Can read as a tech demo, and photos sit awkwardly inside a glyph world.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.case: Loses both axes: the climb becomes a meter.
options.kept: Altitude as the single warm readout with a visible mechanical rollover.

options.label: Pulp Rack
options.thesis: Each camp a lurid paperback cover.
options.case: Loses both axes: doom-laden covers misstate the work.

options.label: Forge Blows
options.case: Loses both axes: smithing has nothing to do with the ascent.
options.kept: One unit per full-width row, measured like chalk marks.

options.label: Memory Quilt
options.risk: Domestic and soft, against a bold adventurous voice.
options.case: Loses both axes: too domestic for an expedition.
options.kept: Every item seamed to its caption with a visible rule.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: Altitude in pixel type at poster scale.
options.risk: The mountain lives only in the type.
options.case: Loses on clarity, edges audience; the climb would be told, not felt.
options.kept: One form repeated at many sizes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark, cinematic portfolio: full-bleed photo hero, big name, project cards below.
canonCard.viewport: Your photo full-bleed, name in large type, a button and links, cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other portfolio by design.
